title: Great app, but one suggestion for smoother experience
body:
I love using this app, but there’s one small tweak that could make a big difference: Currently, if I switch briefly to another app (say, to reply to a quick message) and return within a few seconds, the app still counts it as a full session switch and shows the “Take a deep breath” screen again.

It would be great if there were a short grace period—maybe 30 to 60 seconds—where such quick app switches don’t reset the session. This would really help users like me who multitask and want to stay focused without unnecessary interruptions.

Hope this can be considered in a future update!

title: A change I’d love to see being implemented!
body:
I’ve been using this app for about a month now and even bought an yearly subscription. Love the app and what is strives to achieve, but I have only a single gripe with it, a small change I’d like to see made which would make this even more functional in my opinion. 

Users like me have chosen longer pauses like 10-60 seconds when opening apps so what I noticed was both, the option to opt out of the app and continue the app come into view after the said time passes, which makes it a tougher decision to opt out of it immediately. 

So what I mean to say is please place the button of exiting the app on top of the timer overlay and let the `continue to app’ button remain below the overlay of the timer. Please do consider this as I think people would more often click to exit than wait for both the options to appear and give themselves an excuse to just continue instead. Thank you!

title: Distractions Breaker!!
body: OneSec is a fantastic app that truly delivers on its promise to break distractions and facilitate a phone detox. The app is incredibly easy to use, and it has a variety of features that allow you to customize your experience. Whether you're looking to take a break from social media, or you want to focus on a specific task, OneSec has you covered. The app is also great for scheduling regular breaks throughout the day, which helps to reduce eye strain and promote healthy habits. Overall, I highly recommend OneSec to anyone looking to improve their productivity and reduce distractions.
